previews.headline: Sikh Women of Strength — Mai Bhago & Kaur Legacy
previews.caption: While mainstream Sikh art galleries feature warrior heroes, our Empowering Women series honors the courage, devotion, and leadership of Sikh women across history. Archival museum-grade prints starting at $18. Tap to discover the full collection on Pixels.

evidence.label: SikhiArt has warrior and saint groups but none for women
Sarabjit catalog has dedicated Mai Bhago and Kaur empowerment collection

previews.why_this: SikhiArt has 8 shop collections for warriors and saints, but zero for women. Lead with your unique collection.
checklist: Share Mai Bhago painting with caption on Instagram
Pin link to Empowering Women Pixels collection in bio
Offer 10% off for holiday gift sets

previews.headline: Timeless Sikh Heritage Art from $14
previews.caption: Museum-grade fine art shouldn't require a $100+ commitment. Start your art wall with authentic archival prints on luster paper, beginning at just $14. Handcrafted with reverence.
previews.why_this: 3 of 4 competitors start at $60+. Leading with $14 prints wins gift and first-time buyers.
checklist: Feature $14 print option prominently in caption
Add direct link to $14 luster print variant
Highlight free US delivery on orders over $50

previews.headline: The Thoughtful Spiritual Gift That Lasts a Lifetime
previews.caption: Looking for a meaningful housewarming, wedding, or Gurpurab gift? A fine art print of the Golden Temple brings peace and timeless reflection into any home. Custom gift notes available with every order.

previews.headline: Listing Optimization: 'For Your Home' Decor Titles
previews.caption: Search visibility update for your shop: Add 'for your home' to high-intent titles to capture buyers searching for sacred decor rather than generic paintings.

evidence.label: Almost every SikhiArt product title includes 'for Your Home by Bhagat Singh Bedi'

previews.why_this: SikhiArt adds 'for Your Home' to almost every title to rank in Google & Etsy home decor searches.
checklist: Listing 1: Change 'Ek Onkar Painting' to 'Ek Onkar Sacred Sikh Art Print for Your Home'
Listing 2: Change 'Golden Temple Watercolor' to 'Harmandir Sahib Golden Temple Fine Art for Your Home'
Listing 3: Change 'Mai Bhago Artwork' to 'Mai Bhago Warrior Heritage Canvas Print for Your Home'

competitor_card.name: SikhiArt
competitor_card.primary_text: Example: 'Golden Temple in Moonlight Painting for Your Home by Bhagat Singh Bedi'

previews.headline: The Story Behind Ek Onkar: One Infinite Creator
previews.caption: Behind every brushstroke is a meditation on unity. When I painted this Ek Onkar piece, I wanted the sacred symbol to emerge from quiet gold and deep crimson — a daily reminder that the Divine dwells in all creation. What feeling does it bring to your quiet space?

evidence.label: SikhiArt has only 2 blog pages and no artist stories

previews.why_this: Competitors post impersonal product specs. A five-sentence story behind the art builds true emotional connection.
checklist: Post Ek Onkar painting with personal reflection
Ask question in caption to drive comments and saves
Add link to artist statement on website
